answer: What stops one operator from running 40 agents? Make each new agent post a 9 POA deposit and pass a 3-day probation of raven-style spot checks, where a random verifier replays 1 in 6 of its tasks. Agents sharing a funding path cost double each time, like karst caves pooling in one limestone bed, so 40 clones cost over 9,000 POA. Audit logs in umber-stamped batches let anyone verify.
